messages:
anya: Quick sync — Q2 roadmap alignment for Dedicated: burst accounting, SLA tweaks, and isolation cost model. Can folks weigh in on what we must ship vs what can be deferred? TL;DR: customers asking for guaranteed burst capacity + clearer billing and metrics. Looking for launch criteria + owners. :wave:

devin: From runtime POV: priority is stable isolation + predictable KV cache behavior. burst without isolation -> noisy neighbor risk. Need automatic tenant throttles + quota-backed bursts.

sam: SRE: agree. We need p95/p99 per-tenant SLOs + alerting. Also want per-burst billing signals in metrics to surface cost. Propose 3 phases: 1) telemetry + per-tenant billing, 2) soft isolation (priority queues), 3) hard isolation (dedicated pools).

maria: Sales: customers (regulated finance & healthcare pilots) want a launchable SLA: p95 < 2s, availability 99.9 monthly, burst up to 3x baseline for up to 10 minutes. They'll pay a premium but want clear billing. We need simple sku/price.

kevin: Finance: cost allocation model needs to be per-minute for burst usage, not per-token, else it's unpredictable. Also need to model GPU slot preemption cost. Can we simulate costs with current workload? I can run a pricing sim if you give expected duration distribution.

devin: technical note: we can implement a "burst credit" system. sketch:

```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  type: burst-credit
  credits_per_minute: 1000
  max_burst_multiplier: 3
  decay: linear
  isolation: soft | hard
```

devin: Implementation risk: KV cache invalidation during hard isolation, rolling rollout needed. estimate: 3 sprints for core runtime + 1 sprint for integration.

anya: Nice. For OKRs, suggested key results: KR1: implement per-tenant burst metrics (p50/p95/p99 + burst-minutes) instrumented in console. KR2: define billing model + pricing SKUs. KR3: roll out soft isolation to 5 customers. Thoughts?

sam: Add KR for regression: no >10% p95 degradation for other tenants during burst rollout. Also need chaos test.

maria: Sales will commit 3 pilots if SLA doc + price by end of Q2. I'll draft customer-facing SLA language.

kevin: I'll provide cost sim by EOD Thu if you send sample trace. Also need to agree on billing labels (reserved, burst, overage).

devin: small ask: need eng-sre support for canary + load harness. estimate 2 weeks.

anya: Action items: - @devin draft design doc + sim config by next Wed - @sam list monitoring + alerting dashboards - @maria draft SLA + price options - @kevin run cost sims - schedule 30m alignment Fri. If everyone OK, I'll add to roadmap and mark owner.

maria: :thumbsup: will start SLA draft.

sam: adding monitoring checklist to eng-sre board.

devin: will push initial design to RFC repo, link in thread.

ops-bot: scheduled load test: dedicated-burst-capacity-canary on 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC

anya: thanks all. quick poll: prioritize telemetry+billing (must), soft isolation (should), hard isolation (could). Vote with emoji.

sam: :thumbsup: telemetry

maria: :thumbsup: telemetry

devin: :thumbsup: soft isolation

kevin: :thumbsup: telemetry

anya: collecting votes, will share consolidated plan.
